mapper.select: SELECT banner_id AS bannerId, title AS title, image_url AS imageUrl, link_url AS linkUrl, is_active AS isActive, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, created_by AS createdBy, created_date AS createdDate, updated_date AS updatedDate FROM BANNER ORDER BY created_date DESC, banner_id DESC
